_comment: Immutable version->content record for shipped stack-profile packs (feat-foundry-profile-version-immutability, v0.13.1; extended feat-foundry-standing-versions-matrix, atom ID-SV-1, AC-SVM-4). Each profile id maps version -> {sha256, blueprints_sha256, standing_versions_sha256}, computed exactly as scripts/foundry-stack-profile.py's resolve_lock/relock compute them (content_sha256 over stack-profile.yaml; _blueprints_sha256_of over the blueprints/ subtree, null when absent; _standing_versions_sha256_of over the standing-versions/{manifest.yaml,compatibility.yaml} pair, null/absent when the profile document does not declare a `standing-versions` block -- e.g. the non-infra node-web profile is never driven RED by this field). INVARIANT (registry-immutability, npm/crates.io/Terraform): a profile's (version) maps to FIXED content; changing a profile's bytes REQUIRES a new version + a new entry here. Enforced fail-closed by scripts/foundry_checks/profile-version-immutability.py at /foundry:doctor time AND (transitively, since release-acceptance runs the candidate doctor) at release-cut. This ledger is the published record: it is APPEND/BUMP-only under review, never re-pinned to silence a mismatch. Introduced in v0.13.1; entries begin at the then-current shipped versions (no fabricated history for the pre-ledger 0.4.0 drift). aws-eks-karpenter 0.5.1->0.5.2: ID-SV-1 adds the standing-versions/ pin BOM + compatibility artifacts and declares them in stack-profile.yaml (schema-typed, AC-SVM-5) -- a real content change, hence the bump + this new registered entry (content_sha256 differs from 0.5.1 because stack-profile.yaml itself now carries the `standing-versions` block; blueprints_sha256 is unchanged because blueprints/ was not touched). aws-eks-karpenter 0.5.2->0.5.3: feat-foundry-apply-gate-regrounding (AC-IDAGR-3/-7/-12) rewrites the plan/apply slots to a saved-plan sequence (`plan` writes `-out=.foundry/infra.tfplan`; `apply` applies that same literal path, no `-auto-approve` over a fresh plan) and rewords the header/apply-slot comments off the retired infra framework posture authority -- a real content change to stack-profile.yaml, hence the bump + this new registered entry (blueprints_sha256 and standing_versions_sha256 are unchanged because neither blueprints/ nor standing-versions/ was touched). gv-08 (blueprint kits): python-uv-service 0.1.0->0.2.0, python-uv-lib 0.1.0->0.2.0, node-web 0.3.1->0.4.0, aws-eks-karpenter 0.5.3->0.6.0 each gain the `governance`/`surfaces`/`detect`/`readiness_checklist`/`test_strategy` blocks in stack-profile.yaml plus blueprints/readiness-checklist.md and blueprints/test-strategy.md (covered by blueprints_sha256) -- a real content change, hence the bump + new entries. New profiles service-event-driven, cli-tool, claude-plugin, data-pipeline register at their first versions.
